name: Stable Audio Open
tagline: Stability's diffusion model for **loops, one-shots, drums, textures and FX** up to 47s at 44.1 kHz stereo. Can also make **variations of your audio** (audio-to-audio).
license: Stability AI Community License (free under $1M revenue)

params.name: model
params.help: Any diffusers-format Stable Audio checkpoint works. The official one is gated (see Tips).

params.name: prompt
params.default: 128 BPM tech house drum loop, punchy kick, crisp open hats, groovy percussion

params.name: init_audio
params.label: Audio to vary (optional)
params.help: Starts from your audio instead of noise. Lower strength = closer to the original.

params.name: init_strength
params.help: How much to change the input audio (1 = ignore it).

params.name: waveforms
params.help: Variations per run, generated in parallel.

params.name: eta
params.help: Extra randomness injected at each step (0 = deterministic).

notes:
- **One-time setup:** the official weights are gated. Accept the license at huggingface.co/stabilityai/stable-audio-open-1.0, then run `./zvoid login` in a terminal.
- Put **BPM** in the prompt for loops that fit your grid.
- Great for drum loops, risers, impacts, ambient beds, foley and synth one-shots.
